race.comment: ZATANNA (9) improved sharply when finishing fourth at Balaklava and beaten just over a length by So Polite after working home evenly. at Balaklava. Now peaks third-up, this is an easier assignment and her 1100m record is sound. DASHING RED STAR (3) has upside after breaking through in a Mdn at Balaklava by a neck, and the inside draw gives him a clean chance to build on that. SAMANTH (10) was only fair behind So Polite last start, but her second in a BM68 at Port Lincoln two back reads strongly for this grade and she has proven 1100m form. ARABELLA STAR (2) drops from Saturday company after a Morphettville Class 2 fifth, and while the margin was plain, her distance profile and return of a winning rider keep her in the mix.
